name: How do you plan and add a bathroom to a basement remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do you plan and add a bathroom to a basement remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A basement bathroom requires planning waste line drainage and sub-trade coordination before framing begins. If your concrete foundation slab does not already have plumbing rough-ins, concrete trenching is required to tie into the main sewer line. Tradeoffs involve cost and layout flexibility: placing the bathroom directly beneath upper-floor plumbing stacks minimizes trenching and pipe runs. We coordinate specialized plumbing sub-trades while handling the framing, cement board installation, custom tile work, drywall, and finish trim in-house.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adding a bathroom involves cutting concrete for drain lines, framing walls, coordinating plumbing rough-ins, and installing custom tile and fixtures.
